affiliateDisclosure.title: Affiliate Disclosure
affiliateDisclosure.body: Semiconductores.net may include affiliate links to component distributors and course providers. If you click one and make a purchase, we may earn a commission at no additional cost to you. Affiliate relationships never influence our technical information, specifications, or recommendations — engineering facts come from manufacturer datasheets and are independent of any commercial relationship. All affiliate destinations are managed through a single internal configuration, and we only activate a program after we are accepted into it and have reviewed its terms.

bom.title: Free BOM Analyzer
bom.intro: Paste a bill of materials to check coverage against our catalog and get sourcing links. Basic analysis is free.
bom.privacy: Your BOM is analyzed entirely in your browser. It is never uploaded, stored, or sent to our servers.
bom.pasteLabel: Paste your BOM (CSV — one part per row, ideally with a header like MPN, Qty)
bom.sampleLink: Download a sample BOM to try it
bom.emptyErr: Paste at least one part number, or load a CSV file.
bom.coverage: Basic analysis covers catalog coverage and sourcing links only — no live pricing, stock, or lead times. We never host datasheets; sourcing links go to the manufacturer's listing via Octopart.
bom.ctaText: Send your requirements to our sourcing team for a quote. The free analyzer never sends your BOM — you choose what to share.

apiDocs.title: API for developers & agents
apiDocs.intro: A versioned, read-only JSON API over our owned component catalog. Built for engineers and AI agents: stable URLs, cacheable responses, no key required during the beta.
apiDocs.exampleNote: Every response is JSON with permissive CORS, and is cacheable.
apiDocs.scope: Read-only. Returns factual specifications entered from manufacturer datasheets, each with provenance and a last-checked date. No live pricing, stock, lead times, or purchase authorization. We never host datasheets — each component links to a manufacturer-listing search.
apiDocs.version: The path is versioned (/api/v1). Breaking changes ship under a new version, and the static site stays available even if the API is paused.
apiDocs.coming: A later release adds registered access and per-key rate limits for higher-volume use. The beta is open and read-only.

research.title: Research & the Latin American ecosystem
research.intro: A research-led initiative to help build semiconductor capabilities originating in and owned by Latin America, with an initial focus on Colombia and Peru. This is a long-term, staged ambition — not an existing factory or product.
research.secdNote: Our proprietary computational research direction, applied to stochastic process and defect modeling. Under active development — not yet independently validated on commercial semiconductor production.
research.policyIntro: Public policy we track across the region. Status changes — always confirm at the official source.
research.institutionsIntro: Public universities, agencies and associations active in the regional semiconductor conversation. We track and may seek to engage these — linking them here does not imply any partnership or endorsement.
research.peruRoadmapIntro: From the APCI multi-stakeholder working group (December 2024 report).
research.disclaimer: We reference public institutions, programs and legislation to show the ecosystem we are part of and tracking. Links are to primary (government and university) sources and do not imply partnership, endorsement, or affiliation. Legislation and programs change — verify current status at each official link.
research.ctaText: If you are a university, lab, agency, or company exploring the regional semiconductor ecosystem, we would like to hear from you.

about.title: About the initiative
about.intro: Semiconductores.net is a bilingual platform for semiconductor commerce and intelligence — and the public face of a longer-term, research-led initiative to help build semiconductor capabilities originating in Latin America.
about.whatText: A component catalog and search, engineering calculators, education, a free BOM analyzer, and a read-only API — plus a page that tracks the regional research ecosystem. Everything is bilingual (English and Spanish).
about.ambitionText: Beginning with Colombia and Peru, the initiative aims to develop capabilities across the value chain in stages — research, design, prototyping, testing, and selected manufacturing — anchored by proprietary computational research (SECD).
about.isntText: This is not a factory, a chip for sale, or a claim of validated manufacturing. It is an early-stage, staged initiative. We don't publish partners, endorsements, or capabilities we don't have.
about.ctaText: Research partners, suppliers, universities, and industry contacts are welcome.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This is a general privacy policy for an early-stage site and is not legal advice. It describes how Semiconductores.net handles the limited information it collects.

sections.p: When you submit a form — contact, sourcing request, supplier application, or a course waitlist — we collect what you provide, typically your name, email, and your message or request. We do not ask for confidential designs, export-controlled data, or trade secrets through public forms.

We use Google Analytics 4 to understand aggregate usage. Analytics load only after you accept them in the consent banner, and we send only non-identifying events (such as page views and feature interactions) — never your form contents, email, or message text.
Non-essential analytics storage stays denied until you consent. You can decline, and the site works without analytics.
Form submissions are processed through our hosting provider's form handling (Netlify Forms) so we can respond to you. We use your information only to reply and to provide the service you requested.

Some outbound links may be affiliate links (see our Affiliate Disclosure). Affiliate programs may set their own cookies when you click through; those are governed by the destination's policy, not ours.
We keep form submissions only as long as needed to respond and maintain the relationship. To ask what we hold about you, or to request deletion, contact us through the site.
We may update this policy as the platform grows. Material changes will appear here with a new date.
For privacy questions, reach us through the contact or sourcing form on this site.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These are general terms for an early-stage site and are not legal advice. By using Semiconductores.net you agree to them.

sections.p: Semiconductores.net provides component information, engineering calculators, educational content, a BOM analyzer, and related tools. The platform is informational and is offered on an “as is” basis while it is actively developed.

Calculators, specifications, and other data are for information only and may contain errors. Always verify values against the manufacturer's datasheet. Nothing here is a substitute for professional engineering judgment.

Data may be incomplete or out of date, and we may change or remove features at any time. We do not show live pricing, stock, lead times, or supplier authorization, and nothing on the site is a binding offer to sell.

Site content and design belong to us or our licensors. Manufacturer names, brands, and part numbers are the trademarks of their respective owners and are used only for identification and compatibility reference; their use does not imply affiliation or endorsement.
The site links to third-party sites, including affiliate links (see our Affiliate Disclosure). We are not responsible for external sites' content, policies, or availability.
Do not submit confidential designs, export-controlled technical data, or trade secrets through public forms. You are responsible for the accuracy and lawfulness of what you submit.
To the maximum extent permitted by law, the site is provided without warranties of any kind, and we are not liable for damages arising from your use of it or reliance on its information.
We may update these terms as the platform and its legal structure develop. Material changes will appear here with a new date.
Questions about these terms can be sent through the contact or sourcing form on this site.
